system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Inferno Style

Cost: 1-2 Focus

Like fire jumping a gap, the force of the killing blow carries you to the next enemy.

Once per round, when you defeat an enemy or reduce it to 0 Stamina with a Melee or Ranged weapon attack, you may spend -1 Focus to immediately move up your Speed closer to another enemy. This movement does not trigger attacks or effects that respond to your movement.

Enhancement. If you end this movement with an enemy within your Melee range, you may spend an additional -1 Focus to make one attack against it with a Melee weapon.
